title: Open restriction data for a universal first order thickening
statement: For a universal first order thickening and opens V and U with h(V) ≤ U, there are restricted maps and an open restricted thickening satisfying the compatibility equations and universal property.

source.place: Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Lemma 04FA and Lemma 04F3

proof.text: Construct the open image of V under the homeomorphism underlying the first-order thickening, restrict the closed immersion and factor both structure morphisms through U. The universal lifting property over X restricts to U because a thickening has the same underlying topological space; uniqueness follows from the universal property and monomorphy of the open immersion. This proves every displayed compatibility and the restricted universal property.

lean.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_open_restriction_core
    {Z X Z' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ Z') (h' : Z' ⟶ X)
    (H : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening h i h')
    (V : Z.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    ∃ (hV : V.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme),
      V.ι ≫ h = hV ≫ U.ι ∧ ∃ (V' : Z'.Opens) (iV : V.toScheme ⟶ V'.toScheme)
          (hV' : V'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme),
          i ⁻¹ᵁ V' = V ∧ V' ≤ h' ⁻¹ᵁ U ∧
          iV ≫ V'.ι = V.ι ≫ i ∧ hV' ≫ U.ι = V'.ι ≫ h' ∧
          iV ≫ hV' = hV ∧ IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening hV iV hV'
